maria: Quick Q — when a request includes model_hint=["redwood/accurate","redwood/fast"], which model ends up in served_model? seeing unexpected variants in prod logs.
ashwin: It should pick the highest-priority compatible option: hint order, then region/tier availability, then fallback variants. What mismatch are you seeing?
yoran: Not exactly. For some requests served_model shows "redwood/fast-8bit" even though accurate was first in the hint list. Suspect region+quant compatibility triggered fallback.
maria: Example payload we sent to prod:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model_hint": ["redwood/accurate","redwood/fast"],
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "tier": "standard"
}
```
Response meta: served_model: "redwood/fast-8bit"
ashwin: That can happen if the accurate family isn't available in that region/tier or lacks a compatible quantized kernel. Routing picks the first available compatible variant. Is this on canary or main prod?
maria: Main prod. I opened an infra ticket but wanted API contract clarity: do we promise served_model will always correspond to one of the hinted families (maybe with suffixes), or could we return a different family entirely?
jeff: Short answer: served_model will be one of: pinned model id (if model_pin set), or a model from the hinted families (possibly with variant suffixes like -8bit, -quant) when available. If none of the hinted families are compatible, runtime may choose a different compatible fallback family. We don't currently guarantee family-preservation if hints are all incompatible.
maria: OK — let's make that explicit in the API docs (response semantics) and add an example showing variant suffixes. I'll draft a doc PR.
nashwin: Also propose adding an optional meta field like served_model_reason with values such as "hint-unavailable-in-region" or "quant-compat-fallback" so customers can understand why a variant was chosen.
yoran: Agree but keep the reason values high-level (no internal error codes). e.g., "missing-kernel", "capacity-fallback", "region-restricted".
maria: I'll open two PRs: one doc change and one runtime change to add served_model_reason (opt-in). Ping @jeff and @ashwin for reviews.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/routing-logging #321 -> staging at 2025-05-14T17:45Z :rocket:
jeff: Thanks — pls include a short migration note for customers that relied on family stability.
maria: Will do, thx all :thumbsup:
